title: A Space owner can pay the Founding Year now: Business $441 and Collective $990, no trial, the paid year runs Feb 1, 2027 to Jan 31, 2028

source.ref: Launch milestones doc rulings 2026-11-23 (project thread: Build the Founding Year checkout; owner picked 'Start a thread now' 2026-11-25 00:09Z)

detail: FOUND 2026-11-25: main cannot sell Business at $441. The nine-for-twelve Founding deal exists only for Network (a coupon in space-plan-checkout.ts), Business yearly charges $490, and every Space checkout adds the 14-day trial. Owner rulings 2026-11-23: Business Founding Year $441 and Collective $990, both paid now; the paid year runs February 1, 2027 to January 31, 2028; no trial. Fix: yearly Business or Collective bought before Feb 1, 2027 by a Space with no locked price sells a one-time Founding Year line charged today and holds the yearly price until Feb 1, 2028 (trial_end), no promotion codes; the paid session marks the Space's Founder row; the pricing box, plan receipt and trial-ending notice stop calling it a trial.
